training: Frozen existing full-training balanced-weight probes; no retraining
sampling: Up to 500 validation and 500 test cases per backbone/dataset, independently hash-ranked within validation-defined score-decile x gold-label strata. Round-robin equal quotas with shortage redistribution; exact inclusion probabilities retained.
thresholds: All unique validation probe-score values plus 0, original threshold, and nextafter(1,+inf). No test-score-based threshold construction. Highest threshold on max validation estimated-F1 ties within 1e-12.
nn: Complete original training pool, standardized-activation cosine, immutable-ID similarity ties. Reference probe prediction remains frozen at original threshold across sweep.
evaluation: Horvitz-Thompson TP/FP; exact total positives/negatives; validation-selected thresholds evaluated on independent test sample. Paired within-stratum bootstrap, census strata fixed. Test sweep exploratory; no test-selected optimum claimed.
inference: Existing exact prompts and tokenizer versions, batch 16, max_num_seqs16, max_num_batched_tokens4096, greedy restricted 0/1, seed20261001. Raw outputs and failed attempts retained. No silent judge retry.
reuse: Existing input features/probes reused; no judgment reuse unless identical prompt and complete inference and batch context. This independent sample has different batch contexts, so judgments kept as separate fresh runs.
limits: Prior test inspection makes study exploratory. Partial strata can yield noisy estimates at extreme thresholds. Lower-score explanations require additional preparation; judging ETA excludes that work.

saliency_numerical_reproduction.authorization: User explicitly requested: Just get rid of that consistency check, we do not need it.
saliency_numerical_reproduction.gates: Numerical replay-agreement gates removed across all five backbone saliency paths. No cosine, logit-error, probability-error or bitwise-equality acceptance thresholds. Finite tensor/score validation and input/artifact integrity checks retained.
saliency_numerical_reproduction.backend: Use default configured SDPA for future replays. Remove agreement-triggered math fallback. Preserve existing committed default/math replay artifacts and their provenance.
saliency_numerical_reproduction.fixed: Original features, probes, normalization, routing probabilities, splits, selections, NN representations, thresholds and completed judgments remain authoritative and unchanged.
saliency_numerical_reproduction.records: Retain discrepancy diagnostics and failed attempts; bitwise agreement reported as observed, never assumed. Prior policies archived in repair_v5/PROTOCOL.json.
saliency_numerical_reproduction.limitations: Replay saliency can differ numerically and select different sentences across hardware or kernels. This is not guaranteed exact reproduction of original saliency.
